title: peer-auth: verify draft signed Peer/deliver vector
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00 (jmap-chat-spec c08568e) section 4.2.1 'Example' prints a complete signed Peer/deliver request: Content-Digest, Signature-Input, Signature, signature base, 605-octet body, signed with the RFC 8037 A.1 key (keyid alice.example#kPrK_qmxVWaYVA9wwBF6Iuo3vVzz7TxHCTwXBygrS4k), created=1793379600, expires=1793379900, target https://bob.example/jmap/api/. It was checked against RFC 9421 B.2.6, RFC 9530 and openssl, so it is an external oracle. Add a crate-jmap-peer-auth verify test that feeds the exact headers and body from the draft (unfold RFC 8792 '\\' line wrapping) to verify() with the clock at 1793379600 and expects acceptance; also check the Content-Digest value. Copy the bytes from the draft as literals; do not regenerate them with this crate's signer.
